title: IDEA MATH Summer Program
text:
The Idea Math Summer Program is offered in two locations, Cupertino/San Jose, CA (Day students only) and Boston, MA (Residential and day students). The program is 2 weeks long and is for students entering 6 - 12th grade.

The daily schedule starts at 7:30 with breakfast and ends at 10:45pm with lights out. There are math and physics classes from 9am - 12:15pm, and from 2pm - 5:15pm.

The regular application tuition for the residential program is $3185 in 2014, and for the day program is $1685 in 2014 for Boston. The day program is $1635 in Cupertino.

You can find out more at the website here: http://ideamath.org/summerprog.htm
